title: The Word That Was Deferred
label: ch:ur-word-that-was-deferred
canDo: I can say that I do not understand, put نہیں in front of any verb this book has taught, turn any statement into a yes-or-no question with کیا at the front, and refuse two things at once with نہ … نہ.

payoff.summary: The sentence chapter one explicitly deferred -- میں نہیں سمجھتا -- is said at last, and the question جی ہاں and نہیں were taught to answer eighteen chapters ago can finally be asked.
payoff.note: Every piece of the payoff sentence was already in the book: میں from chapter 4, نہیں from chapter 1, سمجھنا from chapter 7 and the present-tense agreement from chapter 6.
